messages:
tariq: quick follow-up from the postmortem — noticed a recurring pattern: autoscaler thrash around Tuesday product spikes. need owners for quota petitions, emergency scheduler knobs, and a small persistent headroom policy. proposing three focused deliverables with short timelines.

maya: i can own emergency scheduler knobs + the tuning pass. emergency knobs in 3d, full tuning by 12d. plan to test lowering batch size and biasing preemption toward system jobs.

anita: i'll own quota petitions and vendor outreach. opening cloud/vendor tickets today; expect initial replies in 48-72h. will surface any spend approvals.

sam: i'll own headroom policy (reserve + burst lifecycle). propose default reserve = 5% fleet or min 10 GPUs/region. draft by +4d with automation hooks for pre-warm.

jin: i can run the synthetic spike harness and validate canary rollback steps. requesting 6 ephemeral GPUs for ~36h next week.

opsbot: created task REM-9009 and recurring event "GPU Remediation Check" (Tues 09:30 PT). subtasks assigned to owners.

metrics-bot: incident snapshot: peak GPU util 99.4%, autoscaler churn observed for ~2h, headroom dipped to 2%. traces saved to s3://incidents/gpu/2139993333/snap.json

```
Action items (confirm owners/dates):
- QUOTA PETITION: owner=anita, due=+3d, steps=[open tickets, escalate if no reply]
- EMERGENCY SCHEDULER KNOBS: owner=maya, due=+3d, steps=[apply conservative defaults, smoke test]
- HEADROOM POLICY: owner=sam, due=+4d, steps=[policy draft, automation pre-warm, cost cap]
- SURGE VALIDATION: owner=jin, due=+7d, steps=[allocate ephems, run surge sims, post results]
- DASHBOARDS & ALERTS: owner=tariq, due=+2d, steps=[headroom gauge, autoscale-thrash alert]
```

tariq: i'll stand up a tiny tracker and ping finance for temporary approvals. first sync next Tue; please update tracker with blockers before then.

maya: will post config diffs and smoke results into the tracker by day 3.

anita: tickets opened, links inbound.

sam: draft will include pre-warm automation snippets and a rollback play.

jin: requesting ephemeral GPUs approved; will post exact windows in tracker.

metrics-bot: 72h headroom projection: 3-6% depending on region and weekday; recommend pre-warm before launches.

tariq: thanks team — call out blockers ASAP so we can clear before sync.
